title: Expand summary output shown on the public/deployed link

requirements.text: Ensure the summary displayed in the deployed/public app link is noticeably longer and more informative when users upload notes, while keeping quiz questions unchanged.

quotes: summary content is still short in public link.quiz questions are ok

acceptanceCriteria: After uploading a document, the Summary section shows substantially more content than the current short summary (e.g., at least multiple paragraphs when source text contains multiple paragraphs).
Quiz behavior remains unchanged (still renders the existing questions and interaction behavior).
The summary UI renders the full returned summary text without cutting it off (line breaks preserved; no additional truncation in the UI beyond what the summary generator explicitly adds).

requirements.text: When a webhook is configured and returns a very short summary, automatically generate an expanded client-side summary from the uploaded file text and use that instead (or as a fallback), without changing the quiz array returned by the webhook.

quotes: summary content is still short in public link.quiz questions are ok

acceptanceCriteria: If the webhook response summary is below a defined minimum length threshold, the app extracts text from the uploaded file in the browser and generates a longer summary using the same offline summarization logic used when no webhook is configured.
If the webhook response summary is not short, the app uses the webhook-provided summary as-is.
In all cases, the quiz array shown to the user remains the webhook-provided quiz_array when a webhook is configured (no reduction in question count caused by the summary fallback).
User-facing errors remain in English and remain actionable if text extraction fails (e.g., image-only PDF).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx.
Backend remains a single Motoko actor; only add backend changes if strictly necessary for the summary-length fix.
nonGoals: Changing quiz question generation logic or the number of quiz questions (user indicated quiz questions are OK).
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding external databases or non-Motoko backend services.
